pages.title: A First Reference
pages.text: A White Aura Crystal begins this path. Combine one with a Book to assemble the Encyclopedia; its recipe follows. Use the crystal on a Node, then learn how a fueled Pump lifts Aura and falling Aura stores power.

pages.title: Encyclopedia Aura
pages.text: The recipe yields one Encyclopedia Aura.

pages.title: Choose a Path
pages.text: Begin with $(l:aura:white_aura_crystal)the White Aura Crystal$(/l), then continue to $(l:aura:first_aura_circuit)the first circuit$(/l). The $(l:aura:aura_systems)Aura Systems$(/l) section follows power through the network.
